prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single Nunti original mascot style master, not a UI screenshot. Create a polished, highly collectible, lovable original coastal journey creature. It must read as premium 2D character illustration with shallow 2.5D dimensionality, OPAQUE matte pastel color planes and restrained soft edge shadows, NOT a 3D toy, glossy plastic, glass, watercolor stains or airbrushed gradient blob. Design a compact pear/bean body with a naturally integrated cream front, soft mint side/back, one rounded asymmetrical wave crest and a generous curling tail that grows from the back and curls OUTSIDE the body silhouette. Tiny rounded flipper arms and short feet. Low-set large warm dark oval eyes with simple tiny highlights, rosy cheeks, an expressive tiny happy open mouth and an appealing confident head tilt. Excellent clear shape rhythm, clean front view, softly rounded corners, beautifully balanced proportions. Show the destination in the wave-shaped outer crest and curled tail, and the route's winding movement in the OUTER silhouette, not a printed diagram. Smooth unbroken body surface: NO painted route, line, seam, scar, scratch, spot, bubble, stripe, marbling, patchwork, ribbon winding across the torso, or extra floating ornament. One deliberate cream/mint color boundary is enough. No separate giant circular face disk. Colors: soft sea-mint, warm vanilla cream, a small peach tip and rosy cheeks. Full single character centered with generous clear margin. Transparent background. No scene, props, podium, text, icon labels, effects or particles; supporting effects will be animated separately in the app.
